title: ci: bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates
body:
Bumps the github-actions group with 3 updates in the / directory.

Bumps actions/checkout from 5.0.0 to 6.0.0
Bumps actions/setup-node from 4.3.1 to 5.0.0
Bumps github/codeql-action from 3.30.1 to 4.30.9

Release notes

Sourced from actions/checkout's releases.
